summary: burning streets, flames reflect facade of justice every riot begins with The Law lynching a black man may not see a rope but same one pulls communities towards anger, wick on one side noose on other #poemsofpresence
author: Greg McVerry
body_html:
burning
streets, flames
reflect
facade of justice
every riot
begins with
  The Law
lynching a black man
may not see a rope
but same one
  pulls communities
towards anger,
  wick on one side
noose on other
#poemsofpresence
